openers: Honestly, this shirt is all the restraint I have left.
I'm wearing this so I don't have to say it out loud.
This shirt is my polite way of making a point.
Read the shirt, then thank me for my patience.
This is my official customer service face, in shirt form.
I bought this shirt instead of saying what I was thinking.
This shirt explains my silence pretty well.
Somebody had to say it, so my shirt did.
This is the most honest thing I own.
I'm being so nice today, and this shirt proves it.
Every time I hold my tongue, I think of this shirt.
My friends say this shirt is basically my biography.
This shirt deserves an award, and so do I.
I wore this today as a public service announcement.
details: That big coral-red MEAN in the middle is what everyone reads first.
The tall white condensed letters stack so cleanly on the black.
The coral-red slab-serif MEAN really pops against the black cotton.
Look at the tiny white AS next to that huge red word, it's perfect.
It's super soft and fits relaxed without feeling baggy.
The print is crisp, and the white lettering stays bright after washing.
This would make the perfect gift for that one friend who holds back.
The whole message is readable from across the room.
The black fabric makes the white and red lettering look sharp.
It's comfy enough to wear all day, which is good, because I need patience all day.
The layout reads like a slow confession, and the red MEAN lands the joke.
I already ordered one for my coworker's birthday.
followups: Then they tug the hem down so the whole print is flat and readable.
Then they tap the coral-red MEAN and raise their eyebrows.
Then they square their shoulders to the camera and show the full front.
Then they trace each line with a finger, top to bottom.
Then they smooth the shirt with both hands and give a tight smile.
Then they turn slightly and back to the front so the print catches the light.
Then they point to the last line and nod slowly.
Then they step back a little so the entire design fits in the frame.
